subject: Bias audit + escalation path for cross-team calibration — action items
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Bias audit + escalation path for cross-team calibration — action items

Team —

Quick summary: during the cross-team calibration last week I ran the oddity detector on the rating matrix and the delta heatmap flagged a cluster of ~12 employees whose peer comparisons diverge significantly from manager anchors (see attached bias_audit_summary.xlsx and peer_matrix_snapshot.csv). A small subset (~8) look potentially sensitive (high impact, small sample, comp/role mapping differences).

I want us to:
- Triage these 8 sensitive cases through a Privileged Review Lane (redacted binder + HR oversight).
- Define the escalation path when cross-team disagreement > 1.2 SD and manager/peer signals conflict.
- Produce a short playbook that managers can use to route cases (who, when, and what evidence).

Please review the attachments and confirm availability for a 45-minute session this week. I propose Wed 10:00 AM PT for a quick decision meeting.

Also looping in an external compliance consultant (Samantha Ong) for a quick independent read on the criteria — she can join on an as-needed basis for cases that may invoke accommodations or legal risk.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of People Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bias_audit_summary.xlsx (summary + flagged rows), peer_matrix_snapshot.csv (anonymized), redacted_case_binder.pdf (example)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bias audit + escalation path for cross-team calibration — action items

Irene — thanks for the fast look. I skimmed the summary — agree the cluster is concerning. A couple notes:

- We should prioritize the 8 sensitive cases for the Privileged Lane; let's redact personally identifiable fields before wider distribution.
- Monica, can People Ops scope evidence collection (comp history, previous calibrations, any accommodation flags) and prepare a redacted packet?
- We should avoid a full HR investigation unless committee consensus requires it — flagging should trigger a constrained review first.

I can free up Wed 10:00 AM PT for the 45-minute decision call.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Engineering Managers
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bias audit + escalation path for cross-team calibration — action items

+1 on Laura. I'll own the escalation log and the prioritization rubric if we want a single source of truth. Proposed quick rubric fields: risk_score (impact x divergence), manager_anchor_confidence, external_peer_consistency.

Marissa — can you produce a redacted_case_binder.pdf for the first two priority cases by EOD Tuesday so we have something concrete for Wed?

If committee decides to escalate beyond the privileged lane we'll loop CS and Legal, but let's limit noise.

Vivek
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T15:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bias audit + escalation path for cross-team calibration — action items

Thanks — I'll get the binder ready. Deliverables I will attach to the Drive folder:
- redacted_case_binder.pdf (two cases, manager notes removed)
- privileged_lane_playbook.md (template for routing + document checklist)
- snapshot.csv (index of raw flags for audit team)

Question: do we want a two-tier privileged lane (People Ops review first, then committee for cases above threshold) or single-step committee review? My vote is tiered to reduce load.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Manager Effectiveness
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: privileged_lane_playbook.md, redacted_case_binder.pdf
From: Samantha Ong <samantha.ong@peopleops.consult>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bias audit + escalation path for cross-team calibration — action items

Irene/Marissa — thanks for including me. I reviewed the short summary you shared. Quick notes from a compliance lens:

- The tiered approach is sensible. People Ops should perform an evidence hygiene check (redaction + conflict of interest flags) before sending to the committee.
- Maintain an audit trail (who accessed redacted binder and timestamps). I can provide a simple checklist and sample redaction guidance.
- If any flagged case touches protected class or accommodation history, escalate immediately to Legal — do not route through open committee.

I can join Wed 10:00 AM PT for the first 20 minutes; otherwise I'll review artifacts asynchronously.

Samantha Ong
People Ops Consultant
PeopleOps Consult
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Samantha Ong <samantha.ong@peopleops.consult>
Date: 2027-05-22T16:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bias audit + escalation path for cross-team calibration — action items

All — quick recap and decisions from the working thread ahead of Wed:

Decisions:
- Privileged Review Lane = two-tier: (1) People Ops hygiene + evidence packet, (2) Committee review (Irene/Vivek/Laura/Marissa + rotating senior EM) for final disposition.
- Committee only sees fully redacted binders; any PII or accommodation signal triggers immediate Legal consult.
- Vivek will maintain the escalation log (HUBSPOT-12487) and rubric; Marissa will drop the redacted binders in the Drive folder by EOD Tues.

Action items & owners:
- Monica: compile redacted evidence packet for top 2 cases (due 2027-05-25 17:00 PT).
- Marissa: finalize privileged_lane_playbook.md and upload redacted_case_binder.pdf (done).
- Vivek: initialize escalation log and rubric in Drive (HUBSPOT-12487) by 2027-05-21.
- Samantha: provide redaction checklist and sample language by 2027-05-21.

I'll book Wed 10:00 AM PT and send a calendar invite with the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBiasAuditRedacted. Please stick to the evidence checklist to keep committee time under 45 minutes.

Thanks everyone — we'll treat this as a pilot and iterate the playbook after 3 cycles.

Irene Choi
Head of People Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
